published_prior_art.cite: AgarwalHanSahaSyrgkanisYoon2025, Theorem 4 gives LTV SBE-PCR consistency rather than a joint root-N influence expansion or replay covariance.

AgarwalShahShenSong2019, ChernozhukovHansenLiaoZhu2023, and AgarwalHanSahaSyrgkanisYoon2025 provide PCR/low-rank perturbation or sufficient-rate results, not this recursive dependent-proxy necessity frontier.
ChernozhukovChetverikovKato2017 supplies Gaussian approximation for independent-vector sums after the proposed SBE influence array is derived.
CattaneoFengTitiunik2021 treats static synthetic-control prediction uncertainty and contains no fitted recursive donor-reuse replay covariance.
AgarwalHanSahaSyrgkanisYoon2025 provides the recursive SBE setting, but not this displayed covariance calculation; the calculation is a supporting specialization.
AndrewsKitagawaMcCloskey2024 studies inference on a selected winner; Gaussian-band inversion for the proposed finite SBE path vector is downstream.
HiranoPorter2009 gives Gaussian-limit treatment-rule asymptotics; this is its finite-argmax specialization conditional on the new SBE joint law.

soundness_flags.label: thm:joint-expansion
soundness_flags.one_line: The assertion that H is consistently estimable is not well-posed because no estimator \widehat H, norm, or convergence criterion is defined.

soundness_flags.label: ass:proxy-growth
soundness_flags.one_line: The load-bearing p_N>=ell_N N^(2+delta_0) condition is an instrumental proxy-volume strengthening; its justification gives no concrete data-generating design plausibly supplying superquadratically many suitably mixing proxy rows, and the named Korean application explicitly lacks them.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper explicitly labels Section 4.4 as LTV SBE-PCR consistency; Theorem 4 gives an O_p estimation-error bound and states that it yields a consistent causal-estimand estimate.
The paper distinguishes fixed-T1 consistency in Theorem 2 from asymptotic normality with growing T1 in Theorem 3.
The paper gives finite-sample PCR MSE bounds under its low-rank noisy-covariate assumptions.

The article develops conditional prediction intervals for a standard single-treated-unit synthetic-control setup, decomposing uncertainty into pretreatment weight construction and posttreatment error; it does not formulate a recursive causal graph or residual replay covariance.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define an explicit \widehat H from the leave-one-out fitted graph and state a uniform operator- or maximum-norm consistency result; then connect it algebraically to \widehat\Phi and replay covariance.

Replace the proxy-growth justification with a named feasible measurement design and a quantitative proxy-count audit, or weaken the headline to a slower-rate theorem under p comparable to N and retain the frontier as the principal open question.

Add a boundary corollary showing the exact reduction of the full recursion and replay estimator to the published scalar Synthetic-Interventions influence decomposition when T=2 and donor reuse is absent.

recommended_next_step: Revise the undefined influence-coefficient estimability claim and either substantiate or relax the superquadratic proxy-growth regime, then continue this angle.
